## v1.5.0rc1

Release candidate for v1.5.0. This release delivers the full Library experience: a resume-first Home with cinematic heroes and sidebar search, redesigned media detail pages, an origin-encoded SQLite artwork cache behind a localhost proxy, and a disk-backed HLS proxy for Emby playback.

### Highlights
- Redesigned Home with a resume-first hero, sidebar search, and results page; continue-watching cards gained play badges and title-only hover popups.
- Rebuilt media detail pages with a cinematic full-bleed hero, progress-fill play button, and unified video cards behind a shared derivation model.
- Added a SQLite-backed write-through Library Image cache served through a localhost proxy: origin-encoded bytes, digest ETag revalidation, request coalescing, and cache status/clearing controls.
- Added a disk-backed Emby VOD HLS proxy and a direct-playback MPV disk cache profile.
- Now Playing owns its subscription at the shell and maintains a transport snapshot from MPV property observations.
- Restored the active Saved Service Profile on every authenticated entry, with a saved-service reauthentication flow.
- New JellyPilot brand icon and README banner.

### Fixes
- Stopped HLS proxy single-flight followers from parking forever.
- Prevented virtual grid flash on large scrolls and fixed reverse-page prefetching.
- Resolved conditional class conflicts by merge instead of sheet order; composited animated transforms via 3D translate/scale.
- Rendered item details before stream metadata loads.

### Maintenance
- Consolidated playback-target orchestration (MPV events, progress, Emby HLS lifecycle) behind single internal modules.
- Finished the LibraryImage cutover and unified Operations Console image-cache controls.
- Migrated repo scripts from .mjs to TypeScript and enforced a motion invariant in the styling-boundary checker.
- Sped up the test suite with node default and fewer mounts.
